_comment: Register the WhatsApp MCP server in Aside with this shape.
1. The transport literal is 'streamable-http', not 'http'. Aside's schema
does not validate nested server entries, so a wrong value is accepted and
persists silently, giving you a server that looks enabled and does nothing.
2. Writing this config does NOT make the tools callable. Tool discovery only
fires on a UI lifecycle event. After saving, open Aside Settings and toggle
the server OFF and then ON. The tools are then hot-injected into sessions
that are already running. Ground truth for 'is this live' is
Adjust the port if you passed --mcp-port to install.sh.
